options.description: Automatically accepts file edit permissions for the session

options.name: Plan
options.description: Agent can analyze but not modify files or execute commands

options.name: Auto
options.description: An AI reviewer checks each action that would otherwise ask for approval and approves or denies it. A failed review blocks only that action; it never falls back to a prompt or leaves auto mode.

options.name: Don't Ask
options.description: Does not show permission prompts; pre-approved and safe read-only actions run, everything else that would prompt is denied

options.name: Full Access
options.description: Skips ALL permission checks including dangerous commands for all agents
